content.description:
LodeWallet exists to provide the simplest possible experience for Cardano deFi users and a familiar experience for deFi users from other ecosystems.

LodeWallet is the first native Haskell light wallet for Cardano, making direct use of existing open-source Cardano Haskell libraries.
